summary.text: Miriam Paris is a Democratic state representative from Macon who has represented Georgia House District 142 since January 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces Calvin Palmer.
A realtor, she previously served in the Georgia State Senate.

paragraphs.text: Paris was born in Macon, Georgia, and as of January 2020 still lived there.
Her career experience includes working as a realtor.
Paris served in the Georgia State Senate, District 26, from 2011 to 2013.
She took office in the Georgia House of Representatives in January 2017 and has won re-election in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024, defeating Calvin Palmer in the 2024 general election.
She defeated George Thomas in the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Appropriations, Economic Development and Tourism, Education, Energy, Utilities and Telecommunications, and Urban Affairs committees.
